name: Tamura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tamura city emblem in green: an oval enclosing a white four-pointed star with a green lozenge.
history: Municipal flag of Tamura, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 August 2005.

features.role: Tamura city emblem — an oval enclosing a white four-pointed star with a green lozenge
